simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שׁוֹלָל (H7758) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שׁוֹלָל (shôwlâl) means nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive First listed occurrence: Job 12 17.

definitions.full: H7758. sholal שׁוֺלָל adjective indeclinable (Ges § 118o ) barefoot (apparently stripped as to walking; always with הלן ); — וְעָרוֺם שׁוֺלָל אֵילְכָה Micah 1:8 Qr I will go barefoot and naked (Kt שילל ); שׁ יוֺעֲצִם ׳טוֺלִיךְ Job 12:17 , compare 12:19 .
